# LeetPad — https://leetpad.in

> Free browser scratch pad for coding interviews and LeetCode-style practice: arrays, matrices, compact notes, line breaks, and pen marks on an infinite canvas. Open source (MIT).

## For humans
- Site: https://leetpad.in
- Source: https://github.com/edusanketdk/leetpad

## For crawlers
- Sitemap: https://leetpad.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://leetpad.in/robots.txt
